July 03, 2026 
 
Sub: Intimation of Group Meeting with Analysts / Investors under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) 
Regulations, 2015 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the representatives of the Company will be participating in 
group meeting with Analysts/Investors as per the schedule provided below: 
  
 
During the aforesaid meet(s)/call (s), no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. 
 
The ensuing discussions at the aforesaid investor conference(s) would include reference to the 
business/quarterly updates and earnings and corporate presentation for Q4 FY2026 and general business 
overview.     
 
The aforementioned information is also available on the Company’s website at www.capriloans.in  
 
The said intimation was received by the Company on July 03, 2026 at 06:19 P.M. (IST). 
 
We request you to take the above on record and the same be treated as compliance under the applicable 
regulation(s) under the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. 
 
You are requested to take the same on record.   
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
for Capri Global Capital Limited  
 
Yashesh Bhatt
